cutover_matrix.rollback: Return to shadow or reject writes; never restore anonymous writes.

cutover_matrix.rollback: Disable new delivery, drain durable records, keep legacy route read/drain-only.

p0_registry.stop_condition: Any missing principal/scope/signature-or-token/rate/idempotency accepted, unstable reason/audit, replay, cross-principal reuse or secret exposure.
p0_registry.rollback: Set OFF or SHADOW, stop new writes and keep legacy surface deny-by-default; never enable existing insecure bypass flags.

p0_registry.stop_condition: Raw signature failure accepted, duplicate/out-of-order/restart causes duplicate delivery, or inbox/outbox/DLQ loses sequence or payload integrity.
p0_registry.rollback: Set LEGACY_DRAIN, disable new intake with EDGE_GATEWAY_ENABLED=false if needed, drain durable records and prohibit anonymous delivery.

p0_registry.stop_condition: Any Obs write handler remains at final cutover, a query writes, Secure Ingress is bypassed, or a second authority appears.
p0_registry.rollback: Return to SHADOW and reject affected mutations; restore no unauthenticated Obs writer.

p0_registry.stop_condition: Unsigned, digest/SBOM-missing or unsandboxed bundle imports; sandbox/secret/egress escape; provider exception silently selects a fake fallback.
p0_registry.rollback: Set BUILTINS_ONLY, disable hub/custom providers and quarantine the candidate; never restore untrusted hot import.

p0_registry.stop_condition: Mock/self-signed authority accepted, non-Lab network/process action, knowledge leakage, duplicate effect or missing receipt.
p0_registry.rollback: Set READ_ONLY and all existing kill switches false; keep domain evidence and prohibit active probes.

p0_registry.stop_condition: Endpoint lacks unique owner/protocol/health, port conflict is not rejected before startup, or a public bind is unauthenticated.
p0_registry.rollback: Set AUDIT, stop the candidate service and restore only the approved loopback owner; never auto-reassign 18770.

p0_registry.stop_condition: New Edge-to-Host implementation import, Edge standalone install/import failure or contract negotiation regression.
p0_registry.rollback: Revert the affected adapter while FREEZE_NEW remains active; do not disable the guard to accept new debt.

p0_registry.stop_condition: Non-loopback default bind, remote access without auth/scope/rate/audit, replayed device action or any real window/device mis-action.
p0_registry.rollback: Set DISABLED, stop bridge processes, retain audit and use recording/no-device mode.

p0_registry.stop_condition: Any golden/negative/fault case is not repeatable, escapes isolation, performs physical I/O or accepts a broad-exception fake fallback.
p0_registry.rollback: Stop the wave, close every slice through its registered kill switch and preserve failed evidence for diagnosis.
